description: OpenCode plugin: save any conversation as a single portable .sf archive (a real OpenCode database) and restore it later as a native session — on any machine, as many instances as you like. /session-save + /session-load with a native picker and auto tab op

detail.description_zh: OpenCode 插件：将任何对话保存为单个可移植的 .sf 存档（一个真正的 OpenCode 数据库），并稍后作为原生会话恢复——在任何机器上，可以创建任意多个实例。/session-save + /session-load 带有原生选择器和自动标签操作
